description: Analyze with AI, for one Jira story (opened by the AI icon on a story). Reads the story with its sub-tasks and comments from the connected Jira (JQL key = …), and asks the shared Ask AI for an analysis broken into Requirement, Current situation, What to do next, Risks & open questions, an FDD check, and the EquipRite page it lands on. It reads the FDD chosen from the FDD library (the latest unless another is picked): the sections the story names and those that best match it, shown as chips. A chatbot answers follow-up questions grounded in the same story. Rules: resources/js/storyAnalysis.js. Read only.

key.description: The Jira story key (the tab's key).

story.description: The story (jiraBacklog.fromIssue) with subtasks and comments.

pages.description: The EquipRite screens, for the 'which page' suggestion.

analysisHtml.description: The AI analysis rendered to HTML.

chat.description: The chatbot turns: [{ role, text, html }].

analysisAt.description: When the analysis shown was run (ISO), saved or just now.

analysisNote.description: What changed since it ran (a story updated, a newer FDD), with Re-run.

fddLib.description: The FDD library shipped with the app (resources/fdd/library.json).

fddOptions.description: The FDDs to choose from, the latest first: [{ id, label, latest }].

fddId.description: The FDD the analysis reads: the latest, unless another (or none, '') was picked.

fddChosen.description: An FDD was picked on this tab (so a refresh keeps it).

fddPicked.description: The FDD sections the AI read for this story: [{ n, t, why, chars, cut }].

fddView.description: The section open under the chips: { i, n, t, x, parent, why }.

activity.description: The story's whole activity, read from Jira (jiraBacklog.loadActivity): every comment, change and work log entry.

actTab.description: The Activity tab: all | comments | history | worklog.

images.description: The story's images (screenshots in comments, attached images): { attachmentId: url }.

analysisFdd.description: The FDD the shown analysis read ('' when none).
